responses: Hello! How can I help you today?
Hi! What health issue can I assist with?
Welcome to Health Assistant! How may I help you?
Take care! Stay healthy.
Goodbye! Get well soon.
Thank you for visiting. Stay safe!
Drink plenty of water, rest, and take paracetamol. If fever exceeds 103°F, visit a doctor immediately.
Take steam inhalation, drink warm water and rest. If symptoms persist more than 5 days, consult a doctor.
Drink warm water with honey and ginger. Avoid cold drinks. If cough persists more than a week, visit a doctor.
Rest in a quiet dark room, drink water and take paracetamol. If headache is severe or frequent, consult a neurologist.
Avoid spicy food, drink warm water. Take antacid if acidity. If pain is severe or continuous, visit a gastroenterologist.
Rest and drink ORS or lime water. Avoid solid food for some time. If vomiting continues for more than 24 hours, visit a doctor.
Drink ORS solution, avoid oily food. Stay hydrated. If more than 5 times a day, visit a doctor immediately.
Chest pain can be serious. Please sit down and call 108 immediately or go to the nearest emergency room!
This is an emergency! Call 108 immediately. Sit upright and try to stay calm until help arrives.
Call 108 immediately! This is an emergency. Go to the nearest hospital emergency ward right away.
Please call our helpline 1800-XXX-XXX or visit the OPD counter between 9AM-5PM Monday to Saturday.
Monitor your BP regularly. Avoid salt and stress for high BP. For low BP, drink more fluids. Consult a cardiologist for proper treatment.
Maintain a healthy diet, exercise daily and take medicines on time. Monitor blood sugar regularly and visit your endocrinologist.
Avoid scratching the affected area. Apply calamine lotion for itching. Consult a dermatologist for proper diagnosis.
Do not rub your eyes. Wash with clean water. If redness or pain persists, visit an ophthalmologist immediately.
Rinse with warm salt water. Take a painkiller for relief. Visit a dentist as soon as possible for proper treatment.
Rest and apply hot or cold pack. Avoid heavy lifting. Do gentle stretching. If pain is severe, consult an orthopedic doctor.
Apply ice pack and rest the joint. Take anti-inflammatory medicine. Consult a rheumatologist or orthopedic specialist.
Your mental health matters. Please talk to someone you trust. Our hospital has a psychiatry department — please book an appointment. You are not alone.
Our OPD is open Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 5PM. Emergency services are available 24x7.
Our hospital is located at 123 Health Street, Medical Colony. Nearest landmark is City Bus Stand. Google Maps link: maps.google.com
Call 108 for free ambulance service. Our hospital ambulance: 1800-XXX-108. Available 24x7.
I can give general guidance but please consult a doctor before taking any medicine. Self-medication can be harmful.
Common COVID symptoms: fever, cough, loss of smell/taste. Isolate yourself, wear mask and get tested. Contact your nearest health center.
Vaccination is available at our hospital every Tuesday and Friday, 10AM to 2PM. Bring your vaccination card. Call 1800-XXX-VAC for details.
Congratulations! Please visit our gynecology department for regular antenatal checkups. OPD timing: 10AM to 1PM daily.
For child health concerns, please visit our pediatrics department. Available Monday to Saturday 9AM to 4PM. Emergency pediatric care 24x7.
Our pathology lab is open 7AM to 7PM daily. Blood tests can be done without appointment. Reports ready within 4-6 hours.
We accept Ayushman Bharat, CGHS, ECHS and most private insurance. Please carry your insurance card. Contact billing counter for details.
